text:
Predicates:
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
JapaneseCompany(y) ::: y is a Japanese game company.
OnTop10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanMillionCopies(x) ::: x sells more than one million copies.
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x is published by y.
 
Premises:
∀x (OnTop10(x) → ∃y (MadeBy(x, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SellsMoreThanMillionCopies(x) → OnTop10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it is on the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanMillionCopies(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
 
Conclusion:
OnTop10(theLegendOfZelda)
